title: A phenotype-based AI pipeline outperforms human experts in differentially diagnosing rare diseases using EHRs.
summary: A phenotype-based pipeline ranked rare-disease diagnoses from EHR cases and was compared with expert and computational assessments on held-out cases.
organization: Institute for Artificial Intelligence; Tsinghua University

evidence.tested: The phenotype-based pipeline ranked rare-disease diagnoses in held-out EHR cases and was compared with expert and computational assessments.
evidence.unknown: Held-out EHR comparison does not establish benefit from using the pipeline in clinical care.
evidence.ai_role: Ranks candidate rare-disease diagnoses from phenotype information in EHR cases and compares predictions with human-expert and computational assessments on held-out cases.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
